verdict.rationale: Multilingual OCR fidelity is a fair axis for a document parser, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions language support, CJK, right-to-left scripts, or parity with English. The layout-aware OCR and file-format claims are generic and say nothing about multilingual fidelity, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, non-English documents — including CJK and right-to-left scripts — parse with the same fidelity as English
